declared: 2026-11-12, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any RustGM run (obj/parallel/atomic-storage/core/declared.json, batches 1-3). Each case's first line records its prefix: pa31/tests/spec/default-const-closures/count.rs through its Fn trait, followed by a reduced core/sync/atomic.rs Atomic and AtomicPrimitive.

ptr-new.rs.form: core form: const AtomicPtr::new transmutes *mut T into Atomic<*mut T>

ptr-into-inner.rs.form: core form: const into_inner transmutes Atomic<*mut T> back to *mut T

ptr-runtime.rs.form: the same transmute in a non-const fn

ptr-direct.rs.form: control: the normalized field written directly, no projection

unshadowed-value.rs.form: control: without the where clause the projection normalizes to Align8<*mut T>

nested-new.rs.form: control: the same Outer<T> transmute without the where clause

marker-premise.rs.form: control: a premise of a trait without associated types cannot select the projection

param-storage.rs.form: E0512 expected: a type parameter's own Storage is dependently sized

size-mismatch.rs.form: E0512 expected: *const T storage normalizes to a two-pointer Align8, 16 bytes against 8

shadowed.rs.form: E0512 expected: a where clause `*mut T: AtomicPrimitive` shadows the impl, so the projection stays rigid in this body even though new() normalizes it

shadowed-value.rs.form: E0308 expected: the same shadowing where clause keeps the projection rigid for an ordinary value

sibling-shadowed.rs.form: E0512 expected: a method of new()'s own impl adds `where *mut T: AtomicPrimitive`; new() publishes the normal form first, so this checks that published storage does not bypass the shadowing premise

nested-shadowed.rs.form: E0512 expected: the shadowed projection is reached through a repr(C) Outer<T> field

excluded.unrelated-premise.rs: declared accept; rustc accepts; RustGM rejects with "constant storage layout requires a closed normalized type" because a body premise of another trait with an associated type keeps the conservative boundary (base b41f1792 rejects it the same way)
excluded.equality-premise.rs: declared accept; rustc accepts through the premise's Storage equality; RustGM keeps the conservative boundary (base b41f1792 rejects it the same way)
